title: Poetry Assessment EEG Dataset 2
description: This dataset contains 64-channel EEG recordings and behavioural ratings from four participants who read and evaluated 210 short English-language texts: Haiku, Senryu, and non-poetic control texts. Each text was rated on aesthetic appeal, vivid imagery, being moved, originality, and creativity. These participants' recordings were acquired in segments because of session interruptions and were concatenated during preprocessing. They are released as a companion to the main Poetry Assessment EEG Dataset 1 for completeness and transparency.
methods_description: 64-channel BioSemi EEG was recorded while participants read 70 Haiku, 70 Senryu, and 70 control texts across seven blocks, rating each on a 7-point scale for five subjective dimensions. Resting-state EEG was recorded at the beginning and end of each session. Psychometric questionnaires (PANAS, Openness, Curiosity, VVIQ, AVIQ, MAAS, AReA) were also collected. Data were collected at Goldsmiths, University of London.
